index.title: AI-gile: iqembu lakho le-AI lokuthuthukisa, ebhodini elilodwa
index.description: I-AI-gile yibhodi le-kanban lamaqembu e-AI abhala ikhodi. Asebenza ngenkathi ulele; wena uthola inqwaba emfushane yezinto zokuthatha isinqumo, ukuhlola nokwamukela.
hero.lede: Akha ngenkathi ulele. Uvuka kunqwaba emfushane eyodwa: imibuzo embalwa, izinto ezimbalwa zokuhlola, idayimane elilodwa noma amabili ansomi. Chofoza, yamukela, ubuyele ekhofini lakho.
hero.secondary: I-agile, kodwa iqembu alidingi ikhofi le-stand-up. (Nokho liyazenza ama-stand-up.)
pitch.h2: I-AI-gile ngamagama amaningi noma amancane njengoba ufuna
pitch.lede: Khetha ubude, kusukela egameni elilodwa kuya kwangu-144. Ubude ngabunye buyincazelo yabo, ebhalelwe leso silinganiso. Donsa isilayidi noma sebenzisa imicibisholo.
pre.title: AI-gile: kukhona okwakhiwayo
pre.description: Kukhona okwakhiwayo lapha: ibhodi lapho amaqembu e-AI akha lokho okucelayo, futhi akufundise ngesikhathi esebenza. Okwamanje yi-pre-alpha evaliwe nabangani.
pre.line: Ibhodi lapho amaqembu e-AI akha lokho okucelayo, futhi akufundise ngesikhathi esebenza. Okwamanje yi-pre-alpha evaliwe nabangani.
pre.peek: Ngemuva kwengilazi: ibhodi langempela, bukhoma. Ikhadi ngalinye liwumugqa onombala.
pre.peekFake: Ngemuva kwengilazi: libukeka kanje ibhodi elisebenzayo.
f.pile.html: Kuwe iqoqe konke okukulindele kuwo wonke amaphrojekthi: imibuzo, izinto zokuhlola, imisebenzi umuntu kuphela ayenzayo. Ulayini wakho ukutshela ukuthi yini elandelayo nokuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani.
f.sleep.p: Iphrojekthi ngayinye inomholi neqembu lama-ejenti e-AI. Phawula ekhadini futhi iqembu liyavuka, lenze umsebenzi, liwubuyisele nezinyathelo umuntu ozikhathele angazilandela.
f.tester.p: Ngaphambi kokuba kukufinyelele, umhloli ulandela izinyathelo kukhophi yohlelo bese ekukhombisa ayekubonile, ngesithombe-skrini. Hlola ngokushesha okwedlulile bese wamukela ngokuchofoza kanye.
f.proof.p: Ukudluliselwa ngakunye kukhombisa okushintshile: amafayela, umahluko, izithombe-skrini. Akudingeki uvule uhlelo ngalunye ukuze ubone ukuthi sekuphelile yini.
f.chat.p: Umugqa ofana nowe-Discord: isithonjana esisodwa kuphrojekthi ngayinye, amadayimane ansomi kokudinga wena. Thumela umholi umbono; bayiguqulela emakhadini nasepulanini, nenkinobho ethi ✅ Qala.
f.tidy.p: Amakhadi ahlobene ayahlangana abe linye, izihloko ezididayo ziyalungiswa, futhi ukuhlolwa kwamathokheni kugcina ikhodi incane. Izinto ezimbalwa zokushintsha phakathi kwazo, okuncane ongacabanga ngakho.
f.private.li1: Ibhodi lisebenza emshinini wakho futhi lilandela wena kuphela.
f.private.li2: Imilayezo eyimfihlo phakathi kwabantu ibethelwe isuka ekugcineni iye ekugcineni.
f.private.li3: Awekho ama-akhawunti, awekho ama-tracker, awekho amakhukhi.
f.lang.p: Izilimi ezingaphezu kwekhulu namashumi amabili, kusukela esiDashi, isiWelsh nesiJapane kuya umphangi wasolwandle, isiYoda nesiKlingon, nokushintsha ngokushesha kubuyele esiNgisini emagameni ochwepheshe.
f.service.p: Wakhe okuthile nge-AI manje abantu sebekusebenzisa? Kumake njengesevisi futhi ibhodi likusiza ukuyiqhuba kahle: ukuhlola i-uptime, ikhasi lesimo lomphakathi, izigameko ezinokuhlaziywa okubhaliwe, izinguquko ezidinga u-Hamba, izipele ezihlolwa nsuku zonke. Usizo lufundisa isinyathelo ngasinye njengoba uqhubeka.
msgr.h2: AI-gile Messenger: ithimba lakho ephaketheni lakho
msgr.p1: Khuluma nethimba lakho le-AI ngaphandle kokuvula ibhodi. Xoxa nabaholi bamaphrojekthi akho nabangane bakho, ubone izinyathelo zokuhlola zekhadi futhi uziphendule, konke ngefoni yakho.
msgr.p2: Ukuze uyixhume, skena ikhodi ye-QR ebhodini lakho. Okokuqala? Ingxoxo yedemo enobungane izokubonisa konke.
msgr.when: I-Android kuqala, bese kuba inguqulo yewebhu yamafoni ne-iPhone.
msgr.b1: Ukulungiswa kwemodi emnyama sekulungile. Ufuna izinyathelo zokuhlola?
msgr.b3: 1. Vula Izilungiselelo. 2. Khetha Okumnyama. Kubukeka kulungile?
tl.aria: Isikhathi esisukela engxoxweni yokuqala kuya emgwaqweni wesikhathi esizayo
tl.lede: Amadethi nezikhathi zangempela, ngesikhathi sendawo yakho. Ngemva kwanamuhla kuyisu, akukho madethi aqinisekisiwe.
join.lede: I-AI-gile yakhiwa umuntu oyinqaba onentshebe, one-AuDHD nezimpi ezimbalwa nempilo yengqondo, kanye nenqwaba yama-ejenti anesineke. Okwamanje iyimfihlo, kuyi-alpha evaliwe nabangani. Ungathanda ukuzama lapho ivuleka?

privacy.title: I-AI-gile: esikugcinayo
privacy.lede: Ngamafuphi: kuphela lokho osithumelela kona, futhi hhayi isikhathi eside.
privacy.only: Kuphela lokho osithumelela kona: lokho okubhala efomini, njenge-imeyili yakho. Akukho okunye ngawe.
privacy.sealed: Kuvalwa ngophawu ukuze iseva yethu ingakwazi ukukufunda: kusesiphequluli sakho ngaphambi kokuthi kuhambe (esipheqululini esidala, ngokushesha nje uma kufika). Yibhodi lethu kuphela elingakuvula.
privacy.server: Kususwa kuseva ngokushesha nje uma kufika ebhodini lethu. Noma yini esekhona ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-30 iyasuswa noma kunjalo.
privacy.board: Sikugcina ebhodini lethu kuze kube yilapho sesikuphendulile, bese sikususa nalapho.
privacy.none: Awekho ama-tracker, awekho amakhukhi, akukho ukuhlaziywa.
privacy.local: Ulimi lwakho nokukhetha kwakho ukukhanya noma ubumnyama kuhlala esipheqululini sakho. Akukaze kuthunyelwe kithi.
privacy.ask: Ufuna kususwe ngokushesha? Phendula i-imeyili yethu usitshele.
